# bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxatom_mapping

## Summary

Wrapper class for the PMX atom_mapping module.

Perform atom mapping between two ligand structures.

Nextflow adapter of the [Pmxatom_mapping](https://biobb-pmx.readthedocs.io/en/latest/pmx.html#module-pmx.pmxatom_mapping) building block of [biobb_pmx](https://github.com/bioexcel/biobb_pmx) 5.3.0.

## Get started

```nextflow
include { BIOBB_PMX_PMXATOM_MAPPING } from 'bioexcel/biobb_pmx/pmxatom_mapping'

workflow {
    BIOBB_PMX_PMXATOM_MAPPING(ch_input)
}
```

Optional input files are passed as `[]`.

## Inputs

| Name | Required | Formats | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta` | yes | | Map with at least an `id` key, used as tag and output file prefix |
| `input_structure1_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input ligand structure file 1 |
| `input_structure2_path` | yes | pdb | Path to the input ligand structure file 2 |

## Outputs

Each output channel emits `[meta, file]`. Files are named `<prefix>_<role>.<extension>`, where role is the output argument without `output_` and `_path`.
Optional outputs are only produced if requested in `ext.outputs`.

| Channel | Required | Formats (default first) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `output_pairs1_path` | yes | dat, txt | Path to the output pairs for the ligand structure 1 |
| `output_pairs2_path` | yes | dat, txt | Path to the output pairs for the ligand structure 2 |
| `output_log_path` | yes | log, txt, out | Path to the log file |
| `output_structure1_path` | no, opt-in | pdb | Path to the superimposed structure for the ligand structure 1 |
| `output_structure2_path` | no, opt-in | pdb | Path to the superimposed structure for the ligand structure 2 |
| `output_morph1_path` | no, opt-in | pdb | Path to the morphable atoms for the ligand structure 1 |
| `output_morph2_path` | no, opt-in | pdb | Path to the morphable atoms for the ligand structure 2 |
| `output_scaffold1_path` | no, opt-in | ndx | Path to the index of atoms to consider for the ligand structure 1 |
| `output_scaffold2_path` | no, opt-in | ndx | Path to the index of atoms to consider for the ligand structure 2 |
| `output_score_path` | no, opt-in | dat, txt | Path to the morphing score |
| `versions_biobb_pmx` | yes | | `[process, 'biobb_pmx', version]`, also sent to the `versions` topic |

## Configuration

Set with `ext` in a `process` `withName` selector:

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `ext.properties` | Map of Pmxatom_mapping properties (see below). Defaults: `[can_write_file_log: false]` |
| `ext.outputs` | Map of output argument to extension, for example `[output_structure1_path: 'pdb']`. Required outputs use their first format by default; optional outputs are only requested when listed here |
| `ext.prefix` | Output file prefix (default: `meta.id`) |

`raise_error` and `restart` are always set by the adapter: failed commands fail the task, and `-resume` replaces restart.
Do not set the `container_*` properties: Nextflow runs the task inside the biobb_pmx container.

```groovy
process {
    withName: 'BIOBB_PMX_PMXATOM_MAPPING' {
        ext.properties = [noalignment: false]
    }
}
```

### Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `noalignment` | boolean | false | Should the alignment method be disabled. |
| `nomcs` | boolean | false | Should the MCS method be disabled. |
| `noH2H` | boolean | true | Should non-polar hydrogens be discarded from morphing into any other hydrogen. |
| `H2Hpolar` | boolean | false | Should polar hydrogens be morphed into polar hydrogens. |
| `H2Heavy` | boolean | false | Should hydrogen be morphed into a heavy atom. |
| `RingsOnly` | boolean | false | Should rings only be used in the MCS search and alignemnt. |
| `dMCS` | boolean | false | Should the distance criterium be also applied in the MCS based search. |
| `swap` | boolean | false | Try swapping the molecule order which would be a cross-check and require double execution time. |
| `nochirality` | boolean | true | Perform chirality check for MCS mapping. |
| `distance` | number | 0.05 | Distance (nm) between atoms to consider them morphable for alignment approach. |
| `timeout` | integer | 10 | Maximum time (s) for an MCS search. |
| `binary_path` | string | "pmx" | Path to the PMX command line interface. |
| `remove_tmp` | boolean | true | Remove temporal files. |
| `sandbox_path` | string | "./" | Parent path to the sandbox directory. |
